reason: This is a small-file but high-blast-radius executor change: `BaseExecutor` is core runtime plumbing, and removing session context from `ProjectionExec` can affect expression evaluation, required-rows behavior, and session-scoped executor semantics across many query paths. Even if framed as a refactor, changes in `pkg/executor/builder.go` and `pkg/executor/projection.go` are central enough to justify a blocker/high-severity deep review.
